text: Team People A multidisciplinary team of genomicists, bioinformaticians, and ecologists at Tel-Hai College and Migal – Galilee Research Institute. Team list reflects 2022 roster — updates coming soon. S Sariel Hübner Principal Investigator Head of the Evolutionary Genomics Lab and Head of the Bioinformatics Department at Tel-Hai College. Research focuses on the genomics of plant adaptation, speciation, and domestication. Email Google Scholar Lab members G Guy Ben Zvi Graduate Student Graduate student studying transposable elements and their spread along the wheat genome. D Dana Sisou PhD Student PhD student at the Faculty of Agriculture, Hebrew University of Jerusalem, studying the genetic basis of sunflower resistance to broomrape (Orobanche cumana). E Evgenii Potapenko PhD Student PhD student at the Department of Evolutionary and Environmental Biology, University of Haifa, investigating the impact of recombination and mobile element activity on adaptation in wild barley. Y Yael Lev-Mirom PhD Student PhD student at the Department of Evolutionary and Environmental Biology, University of Haifa, studying wheat domestication and crop evolution. R Roy Friedlander Research Programmer Computer science graduate specializing in signal processing and machine learning. Establishes cloud-native computing infrastructure for genomic data analysis and develops tools for graph pan-genome analysis. T Tal Amar Undergraduate Student Undergraduate student in the biodata (computational biology) program at Tel-Hai College.
